item.title: Legendary German Rock Band Scorpions to Perform in Shillong On April 21
item.description: GUWAHATI: Legendary German rock band Scorpions are set to return to India after nearly two decades, kicking off their much-anticipated Coming Home 2026 Tour in Shillong. The band will perform live at JN Stadium on April 21, placing Meghalaya’s capital at the opening of a major global rock tour. item.title: 12th Inter-District Roller Skating Championship to Be Held in Guwahati's Dispur
item.description: GUWAHATI: The 12th Inter-District Roller Skating Championship will be held on January 10 and 11 at the Dispur Roller Skating Rink. item.title: Guwahati to Host 8th Aanrkapor Theatre Festival on January 9–10
item.description: GUWAHATI: The 8th theatre festival organised by Aanrkapor, a leading theatre organisation of the Northeast, in collaboration with the Cultural Affairs Department, Government of Assam, will be held on January 9 and 10 at the Sri Sri Madhadeva International Auditorium, Kalashetra. The two-day event will include theatrical performances, musical tributes, and an award ceremony recognising contributions to Assam’s theatre scene. item.description: GUWAHATI: A fire broke out at a bus body garage near the Lokhra market area in Guwahati in the early hours of Thursday, January 8, causing extensive damage to vehicles and machinery. item.title: GNRC Hospitals Observes 40th Foundation Day
item.description: GNRC Hospitals, Dispur, on Monday, January 5, observed its 40th Foundation Day with a day-long programme that included official addresses, award ceremonies and a Continuing Medical Education (CME) session on trauma care and prevention. The programme was attended by senior government officials, healthcare professionals, media representatives and hospital staff. item.title: Phones, Ads and Silence: The Price Assam Pays for a Friendly Press
item.description: GUWAHATI: The quiet return of government-issued smartphones by two journalists in Assam has sparked a controversy far larger than the devices themselves.
